questions.question: The Ask provider lives across routes, so an explanation of a July/DUB figure stays in the dock after the user generates a DIFFERENT statement — making an old answer look like it belongs to the new numbers. What should happen to grounded explanations when the statement changes?
options: Clear grounded turns on a new statement (Recommended)
Keep them, but visibly stamped with their statement
questions.chosen: Clear grounded turns on a new statement (Recommended)
